text: Scala 3 generic fixed-arity apply boxed Rank3/Rank4 primitives (~24 B/element) despite correct semantics. The released path therefore uses inline erased-type dispatch to exact primitive platform accessors, with boxed fallback only when A remains abstract. Helpers are @publicInBinary private[ravel] to avoid unstable generated accessor names. A one-off -WunstableInlineAccessors compile found no new NDArray/MutableNDArray/ArrayBuilder helper warnings, but exposed 71 pre-existing warnings in BorrowedNDArray/internal kernels; the global flag was not added because repairing unrelated inline surfaces is outside this issue.
